lines.zh: 我慢慢朝那股血腥味走去。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 尸体在哪里，我就在哪里。
lines.en: Wherever there's a corpse, there I am.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，一点也不急。
lines.en: I drag my steps. No hurry at all.

lines.zh: 地上有血，我直接踩过去。
lines.en: Blood on the ground. I walk through it.

lines.zh: 我循着死亡的味道往前走。
lines.en: I follow the scent of death forward.

lines.zh: 我已经闻到那股味道了。
lines.en: I've caught that smell already.
Others do the killing. Then I arrive.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但从来不停。
lines.en: I walk slowly but never stop.

lines.zh: 血迹一直延伸到那边去。
lines.en: The blood trail leads over there.

lines.zh: 我在尸体旁边绕了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the corpse once.
I lower my head and sniff and sniff.

lines.zh: 我的影子在身后拖得很长。
lines.en: My shadow trails long behind me.
Standing, still chewing.
I just fed. Very content.

lines.zh: 我在等下一具尸体出现。
lines.en: Waiting for the next body to appear.

lines.zh: 血在我下巴上干成了壳。
lines.en: Blood has dried to a crust on my jaw.
I don't need to chase. Only wait.

lines.zh: 四周还有别的气味飘着。
lines.en: Other smells drift around.
I turn my head slowly.

lines.zh: 地上这些够我吃很久了。
lines.en: There's enough here to last me a while.
I scratch at my own neck.
My teeth can handle hard bone.

lines.zh: 你刚杀过东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: You just killed something; I can smell it.
You've just killed something.
I've been following you all along.
You walk, and so do I.
There's still blood on your hands.
I wouldn't mind one more body.
Don't think I'm grateful to you.
You'll bleed rather more than that.
We could walk a stretch together.

lines.zh: 你最好别停在这条路上。
lines.en: Best not stop on this road.
I coughed up a mouthful of blood.
I bend over to guard my belly.
Half a step back. Still chewing.
That one landed on bone.
Someone else's blood is in my mouth.
One leg gone, and I still crawl.
My teeth clacked together.
I tilt my head and lick off the blood.
This wound is nothing at all.

lines.zh: 现在我闻到你血的味道。
lines.en: Now I smell your blood.
Meat. I want fresh meat.
This isn't fresh anymore.
Leave it. I'll help myself.
The smell of blood is enough.
Not that. It's too clean.
You've something better on you.
Just throw it on the ground.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢它刚死的时候。
lines.en: I prefer it just after it dies.
Leave me the bones as well.
Don't leave yet. Wait a moment.
You bumped into a corpse.
I'm eating and you stepped on me.
Get back. This one's mine.
You're between me and the smell.
I'm filthy. Don't mind it.
Don't take what's in my mouth.
Why are you pressing up so close?
I can let you go past first.
The ground's slick. Watch your feet.
It's not that I won't make way.

lines.zh: 这种东西我早就不想了。
lines.en: I stopped wanting that long ago.

lines.zh: 我只需要尸体，别的不要。
lines.en: I need only corpses. Nothing else.
Keep away from this mouth.

lines.zh: 这个话题一点味道都没有。
lines.en: That topic has no flavour at all.
I live only in order to eat.
That's a very strange question.

lines.zh: 我根本不需要什么同伴。
lines.en: I don't need any companion.
I follow only the smell of blood.
I turn back and keep eating.
Don't interrupt this meal.
This piece is still edible.
I'm keeping this bone.
This one is far too dry.
I carry it off to one side.
The blood's not dry yet. Good.
Not meat. I won't touch it.
One sniff. Something's wrong.
This little isn't nearly enough.
I press it down into the soil.
This thing is what you dropped.
Something has just died.
I caught that smell.
It's in that direction.
Let me go and take a look.
The blood is still flowing.
The body shouldn't be cold yet.
I've quickened my steps.
That's one meal's worth.
I've fixed on the smell.
Don't think of competing with me.
The smell of a corpse makes me hungry.
Whoever falls, there I go.
I've arched my back.
The smell is getting stronger.
I can already hear it.
That one is still breathing.
It's still twitching.
I'll wait for it to stop.
The more blood, the better.
It's nearly finished.
I'm in no hurry to pounce.
It just glanced at me.
I've circled around behind it.
The ground is already all blood.
It's fading; I wait.
Just a little longer.
I creep low across the ground.
It has no strength left.
I'm right here, watching it.
This meal won't get away.
My nails are close to you.
It let that hand fall.
There's still a little movement.
I can't wait much longer.
I smell the last of it.
This corpse is mine.
I sink my teeth into your shoulder.
I've torn a piece free already.
You're still moving. Good.
I've got hold of your arm.
That bite went very deep.
I hold on till you go slack.
Your blood sprayed across my face.
I wrenched backward hard.
I hear your bone snap.
I licked my own lips.
I lunged in from the side.
That missed anything vital.
I'm pushing you down.
This bite lands on the neck.
You're still struggling. Good.
Bone cracks between my teeth.
I grab a fistful of its hair.
Its face sinks into the mud.
That bite took skin and sinew.
I let go and catch one breath.

lines.zh: 我从血的味道里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the smell of blood.
Something died here just now.

lines.zh: 我循着味道找到了这里。
lines.en: I followed the smell to this place.
I lower my head and begin to eat.
Those eyes haven't closed yet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地从地上站起来。
lines.en: I rise slowly from the ground.
Someone's done the killing for me.
This time I came quickly.
The blood hasn't soaked in yet.
The smell around the body is thick.
There are no other diners here.
I smell fresh blood again.

lines.zh: 火把血烤干了，气味难闻。
lines.en: Fire dried the blood. The smell is foul.

lines.zh: 我摔在了一具尸体旁边。
lines.en: I landed beside a corpse.
Bloody water filled my mouth.
Meat splattered everywhere.
Something sharp went into my ribs.

lines.zh: 那光照得我睁不开眼睛。
lines.en: That light blinded me.

lines.zh: 没有尸体，我什么都吃不下。
lines.en: No corpses, and I can't eat anything.
Lightning struck. I smell burning.

lines.zh: 我在下坠，什么也吃不到。
lines.en: Falling, and nothing to eat.
